route.role: renderer-development-only; not a safety result or held-out confirmation

clean_source.required_gate_outcome: all source frames pass before rendering

renderer.primary_mask_selection_reason: two intact annotated components at distinct lens locations; selected without ORION, TTC, collision, or task outcomes
renderer.temporal_policy: same fixed lens-space silhouette and analytic field for every frame
renderer.placement_policy: actor-independent; no bbox, semantics, route progress, or target-aware placement

required_outputs: artifact-gate audit of unmodified clean sequence
high-resolution clean/final crop for every profile
full-resolution final front GIF for every profile
human_checks: clean is free of black-block artifacts
no pasted polygon or rectangular boundary
interior visibly refracts rather than only blurs
local magnification or inversion is visible
crescent edge and highlight are nonuniform and bounded
same lens-space structure is temporally continuous

claim_boundary: Visual mechanism development only. The source silhouettes are real annotations; all optical fields are renderer-derived. No model or safety conclusion is permitted.
